question: Does Driving Layup tendency influence CPU layup selection after a drive begins, rather than layup success?

sources.author: UNKNOWN
sources.evidence: CPU-v-CPU thirty-team tournament reports average Driving Layup Tendency 52 and excessive interior attacks; no isolated field intervention
sources.limitations: Other sliders modified; direct webpage fetch intermittent, indexed full article available; no causal threshold

sources.author: CelticLG
sources.platform: Multi-platform roster project; exact PC build UNKNOWN
sources.evidence: Project differentiates drive and dunk tendency edits

sources.author: NBA2KW editorial, individual byline UNKNOWN
sources.evidence: Driving Layup ATTRIBUTe describes making moving layups, not choosing to attempt them
sources.limitations: Attribute and tendency must not be equated

sources.author: King Gro23
sources.evidence: Interprets layup choice as competing with dunk, pullup and close shot; posts #376/#380
sources.limitations: No verified PC22 effect or internal decision tree

claims.claim: Observed average tendency and interior-heavy play coexist in one 2K22 tournament
Finishing skill and finishing choice are separate research objects
Layup-versus-dunk and close shot may compete after a drive

conflicts: No PC22 isolated intervention supports S4 deterministic prioritization
S1 average 52 is a descriptive value, not recommended threshold
related: Driving Dunk and Shot Close as possible competing action categories
Layup attribute, fatigue, contest, badges as success confounders
observable_metrics: layup attempts per eligible CPU drive
alternatives: dunk, pass, pullup and close shot

Gemini_REA_question.question: Do read-only candidate PLAYER+0x459 bytes for two identified PC22 players agree with each player's native in-game UI Driving Layup tendency value under the same save/build/time?

next_improvement: After UID mapping, isolate 3D drive opportunities and finish choice while keeping other tendencies and coach strategy fixed
